snippet.title: Announcement Trailer | Mortiscript Undead Auto Battler
snippet.description:
A game where you don't fight. You program your undead army, then watch them carry out every order exactly as written. When the plan fails, the game shows you why.

MORTISCRIPT: Undead Auto Battler is a dark fantasy strategy RPG about programming an undead army. Every order is a simple rule, WHEN → ACTION → TARGET, built from blocks. You never write a line of code.

Wishlist it on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5264940/MORTISCRIPT_Undead_Auto_Battler

Or search MORTISCRIPT, or use the link on my channel.


What's the first order you'd give your undead?
